title: Kimi Antonelli becomes F1 world champion as Max Verstappen wins Mexico City Grand Prix - BBC
description: Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history as Max Verstappen wins the Mexico City Grand Prix.

title: Lamar Jackson needs surgery, headed to injured reserve with thumb injury sustained in loss to Bills - Yahoo Sports
description: Jackson's headed to injured reserve with a significant injury to his thumb.

title: Ukraine's air raid alert system hacked, Air Force says as false nuclear, chemical warnings sound - The Kyiv Independent
description: Ukraine's air raid alert system was hacked late on Nov. 1, the Air Force said as sirens sounded across the country, falsely notifying people of nuclear, chemical, and street fighting threats.

title: Nine killed in Florida plane crash - BBC
description: Transport Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash, which happened nine miles from President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort, as a "horrific tragedy".

title: AI investors hedge against losses amid tech stock selloff - The Jerusalem Post
description: As AI stocks tumble and borrowing costs rise, investors turn to put options and credit-default swaps to protect gains and limit potential losses.
